bands_check: Five light bands on each of the two square screens, with red joinery visible through intervening slots. At the other station the five bright back ranges are v169–172,177–180,185–188,192–196,200–203 around u319. The edge at v178 in the larger view belongs to the light upper soffit. The colour readings are used to distinguish real lamellae from painted stripes.

pool.limitation: Visible rim sampled on the far garden view. The raised front below the glazed sill and the lower grassy foreground admit offset uncertainty. Elevation held conditionally at -0.12 m relative to the terrace, with estimated uncertainty 0.20 m. The visible oval is represented by a smooth edge fitted on that plane; the park beyond is outside this model.

mullions.curtain: The pale translucent central curtain and the garden-side pane have different colours in the two publications. Model has a separate interior fabric and transparent glazing.

cap_profiles.description: The first registered model under-ran the actual dark roof top at photograph x=300. Fit independent points on both photographs on the observed forward eave plane. Thin belly of the near-white fascia has lower local contrast than its dark top. Sample centres do not include the held-out x300 top-edge ray. The small gradient is a camera-conditioned construction line.

outer_screen.comment: At the photograph’s far left, four exposed pale ends appear through the near tree. The hidden fifth and the occluded far side of the screen are not extended. The photographed white tips are broader than the formerly cut glazing end.
